official.deadline_note: UTS publishes one single closing date for this scholarship (02/11/2026); the page states no separate institutional deadline that differs from the programme application deadline, but applicants must also meet UTS admission criteria for their selected undergraduate program by this same closing date.
official.status_note: The scholarship page lists STATUS as Open, with Application Open 01/10/2026 and Application Close 02/11/2026, and states the application period for Autumn session 2027 (February 2027 commencement) runs Thursday 01 October 2026 to Monday 02 November 2026 11.55pm AEST.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official page lists VALUE as 'UTS Tuition Fees', and the UTS international scholarships hub describes it as a 'Full tuition scholarship for the standard course duration'. No living-cost, travel or installation payment is published for this scholarship.
benefits: UTS Tuition Fees (full tuition for the standard duration of the UTS course)

Meet UTS admission criteria for the selected UTS undergraduate program by the closing date of the scholarship application
Commence full-time studies and on campus (Sydney)

All applicants must apply using the UTS online Scholarships Application form to be eligible
Must not be studying a UTS online degree or distance mode degree

requirements: Apply using the UTS online Scholarships Application form

Separately meet UTS admission criteria for the intended undergraduate program by the same closing date
official.application_route: Apply online through the UTS online Scholarships Application form (FormId 870) during the stated application period.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must remain an international student, defined as not an Australian citizen, New Zealand citizen or permanent resident of Australia.
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students only (domestic students are excluded by the international-student requirement).
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Available across UTS undergraduate programs; applicants must not be enrolled in a UTS online degree or distance mode degree.
official.description: Established to support high achieving commencing international students enrolling in an undergraduate program at UTS in Sydney, the scholarship is offered to international students who exhibit the University's core values and can demonstrate commitment to excellence, innovation, entrepreneurship and social justice. UTS describes it as a full tuition scholarship for the standard course duration.
official.program_type: Merit-based scholarship for high-achieving commencing international undergraduate students
official.english_requirement: Applicants must meet UTS admission criteria for the selected undergraduate program, which include the program's English language requirements. For most undergraduate coursework courses UTS requires IELTS (academic/online/OSR) 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing, TOEFL internet-based 79 overall with 21 in writing, PTE Academic 58 overall with 50 in writing, or C1A/C2P 176 overall with 169 in writing. Nursing, Midwifery and combined teaching courses require higher scores, and English test results must be obtained less than two years before application to UTS.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a full-tuition waiver for one student entering a UTS undergraduate degree in Sydney, worth roughly AUD 110,000-140,000 over a standard three-to-four year degree depending on the course. Because the window is only about four weeks (1 October to 2 November 2026), treat it as a two-part race: secure a UTS course offer that meets admission criteria and file the separate scholarship form before 11.55pm AEST on 2 November. The award is highly selective and ranked, so an 85% average alone is a threshold, not a guarantee - the written responses in the scholarship form carry real weight.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent school leavers (Australian Year 12 or equivalent completed within the last three years) averaging 85% or better who want a full-fee-waiver at a technology-focused Sydney university.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your UTS course application is submitted well before 2 November - admission criteria must be met by the scholarship closing date, not after
Draft the scholarship form responses around UTS's stated values: excellence, innovation, entrepreneurship and social justice
Check your qualification is within the three-year window measured from commencement, not from application
Verify your average converts to at least 85% where the pass mark is 50%, and keep a grading-scale explanation ready
Confirm you hold no other UTS International Grant or Scholarship that would disqualify you unless an exception applies
Ensure your course is delivered on campus in Sydney, not as a UTS online or distance-mode degree
common_rejection_risks: Finishing Year 12 more than three years before the February 2027 commencement, which voids eligibility regardless of marks
Averaging below the 85% threshold measured against a pass mark other than 50% without an accepted equivalence
Submitting only the course application and forgetting the separate scholarship form, or vice versa
Being admitted on a foundation, diploma or pathway qualification rather than the Year 12 or comparable qualification the rule requires
Holding another UTS international scholarship simultaneously without an approved exception
Weak or generic answers in the scholarship form, since ranking combines academic merit with those responses
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Everything except tuition: UTS publishes no stipend, travel or installation payment for this award. You must self-fund Sydney living costs (roughly AUD 25,000-35,000 per year), Overseas Student Health Cover, the student services and amenities fee, visa costs, flights, textbooks and course materials.
document_audit: Your high school qualification must be the basis of your UTS admission - admission granted on other grounds can invalidate the claim
The three-year clock runs from your UTS commencement date (February 2027), not from the application date
The 85% average is defined against a 50% pass mark; other grading scales need an equivalence UTS accepts
English test scores must be under two years old when you apply, and some courses require well above the standard 6.5 IELTS
alerts: The application window is short (1 October to 2 November 2026) and closes at 11.55pm AEST - convert that to your local time before relying on it
Tuition is paid directly into your UTS student fee account, so you will not receive cash and must still show funds for living costs for your visa
Holding more than one UTS scholarship is generally not permitted, so weigh this full-tuition award against smaller percentage awards you may already hold
If your study circumstances change after accepting, ongoing eligibility conditions in the Conditions of Award still apply and non-compliance can pause payments
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Lodge the UTS course application first, then complete the UTS online Scholarships Application form (FormId 870) before the 2 November 2026 deadline; UTS ranks eligible applicants and offers the single highest-ranked applicant.
